formulas.rediscovery_avoided: baseline phase-B total - agentify phase-B total (paired attempts with complete telemetry)
formulas.break_even: ceil(incremental phase-A seed cost per pair / phase-B cost avoided per recall session)
formulas.repeated_failure_cost_avoided: baseline phase-B spend where agentify passed and baseline failed on a prior-failure-avoidance task

verdict.reason: no winner declared: pass-rate confidence intervals overlap
